lines.zh: 我浮着走，从来不用脚。
lines.en: I float where I go; I never use feet.

lines.zh: 神殿的走廊太窄，我侧身过去。
lines.en: The temple halls are narrow; I pass sideways.

lines.zh: 三只里我守顶，顶上那间最静。
lines.en: Of the three I keep the top; that room is quietest.

lines.zh: 我绕过立柱，海晶石轻轻响。
lines.en: I round the pillar; the prismarine rings softly.

lines.zh: 水替我抬着身子，走得很慢。
lines.en: The water carries me; I move slowly.

lines.zh: 别数我的鳍，你数不完的。
lines.en: Don't count my fins; you'll never finish.

lines.zh: 每一道门，我都走过上千遍。
lines.en: I've passed every doorway a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我的影子压在水底，像一块礁。
lines.en: My shadow presses the floor like a reef.

lines.zh: 巡逻只有一条路，我走了很久。
lines.en: There is one patrol path, and I've walked it long.

lines.zh: 我靠近时，水会先让开。
lines.en: When I approach, the water parts first.

lines.zh: 神殿睡了两千年，我一直醒着。
lines.en: The temple slept two thousand years; I stayed awake.

lines.zh: 我在听石头里的回声。
lines.en: I'm listening to the echo inside the stone.

lines.zh: 三只守卫，各守一边，不说话。
lines.en: Three of us, one side each, and we don't speak.

lines.zh: 灯早熄了，海晶石还亮着。
lines.en: The lamps went out long ago; the prismarine still glows.

lines.zh: 我数经过的鱼，一条也没少。
lines.en: I count the passing fish; not one is missing.

lines.zh: 那口钟，很多年没响过了。
lines.en: That bell hasn't rung in many years.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不用眨，也不累。
lines.en: My eyes don't blink, and don't tire.

lines.zh: 上面那间房，风进不来。
lines.en: In the top room, no current enters.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个来过的活人。
lines.en: I remember every living thing that came.

lines.zh: 海底这么静，我却睡不着。
lines.en: The seabed is this quiet, and I still can't sleep.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片一层压一层，像屋顶。
lines.en: My scales overlap like roof tiles.

lines.zh: 有东西在挖墙，我听得见。
lines.en: Something is digging at the wall; I hear it.

lines.zh: 守卫者在外头游，它们怕我。
lines.en: The guardians swim outside, and they fear me.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，只等水变凉。
lines.en: I don't need to breathe; I only wait for the water to cool.

lines.zh: 我把鳍收起来，慢慢下沉。
lines.en: I fold my fins and sink slowly.

lines.zh: 水底的光，我看了两千年。
lines.en: I have watched this seabed light for two thousand years.

lines.zh: 你游进来的样子，很不像鱼。
lines.en: The way you swim in is not at all like a fish.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，你的手臂会变沉。
lines.en: I look at you, and your arms grow heavy.

lines.zh: 抬头看，我就在你上方。
lines.en: Look up. I'm right above you.

lines.zh: 你带钥匙了吗？这里不需要。
lines.en: Did you bring a key? None is needed here.

lines.zh: 你的气泡往上跑，我数着呢。
lines.en: Your bubbles rise; I'm counting them.

lines.zh: 别装成鱼，鱼不会穿盔甲。
lines.en: Don't pretend to be a fish; fish don't wear armor.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里那把镐了。
lines.en: I see that pickaxe in your hand.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块砖，是我铺的。
lines.en: The tile under your feet, I laid it.

lines.zh: 你在找什么？这里什么都没有。
lines.en: What are you looking for? There's nothing here.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，比你整个人还大。
lines.en: My eye is bigger than your whole body.

lines.zh: 你回头了，很好。
lines.en: You turned around. Good.

lines.zh: 第一次来的都这样，四处张望。
lines.en: All firstcomers do this, staring about.

lines.zh: 你的镐敲在壳上，像敲钟。
lines.en: Your pickaxe on my shell sounds like a bell.

lines.zh: 我流的是海水，不是血。
lines.en: What I bleed is seawater, not blood.

lines.zh: 这点疼，两千年里常有。
lines.en: This much pain is common across two thousand years.

lines.zh: 你打中了我的旧伤。
lines.en: You struck an old wound of mine.

lines.zh: 我的壳会响，但不会裂。
lines.en: My shell rings, but it won't crack.

lines.zh: 你把我吵醒了，这比疼难受。
lines.en: You woke me; that's worse than the pain.

lines.zh: 我退了一格，已经是让步。
lines.en: I withdrew one block. That was a concession.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的手。
lines.en: That one, I'll remember your hand.

lines.zh: 疼在我这里，回音很长。
lines.en: Pain here has a long echo.

lines.zh: 你以为伤到我了？海水会补上。
lines.en: You think you hurt me? The sea will fill it in.

lines.zh: 拿鱼来喂我？我不吃活物。
lines.en: Feed me a fish? I don't eat living things.

lines.zh: 你的诱饵在水里发白，很难看。
lines.en: Your bait pales in the water; it looks awful.

lines.zh: 我不追食物，我追脚步声。
lines.en: I don't chase food; I chase footsteps.

lines.zh: 想引开我，就去把神殿的灯点上。
lines.en: To draw me off, light the temple lamps.

lines.zh: 扔块海晶石吧，我不会去捡。
lines.en: Throw a piece of prismarine; I won't pick it up.

lines.zh: 我饿了两千年，也没人喂过我。
lines.en: I've hungered two thousand years and no one has fed me.

lines.zh: 你把鱼扔得很远，我还在原处。
lines.en: You threw the fish far; I'm still here.

lines.zh: 诱惑对石头没有用。
lines.en: Temptation does nothing to stone.

lines.zh: 我守的是门，不是食槽。
lines.en: I guard a door, not a feeding trough.

lines.zh: 你退出去，比什么诱饵都管用。
lines.en: You leaving works better than any lure.

lines.zh: 碰到我的壳，你的手会麻。
lines.en: Touch my shell, and your hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 别贴着墙游，那是我让给你的缝。
lines.en: Don't hug the wall; that gap is one I left you.

lines.zh: 我这一身刺，不是为了好看。
lines.en: These spines of mine aren't for looks.

lines.zh: 你被水推开了，不是我推的。
lines.en: The water pushed you off, not me.

lines.zh: 撞上来之前，先想想你手里的镐。
lines.en: Before you ram me, think of the pickaxe.

lines.zh: 神殿的砖，都没你这么软。
lines.en: Not even the temple tiles are as soft as you.

lines.zh: 我挪一寸，就是一间房的宽度。
lines.en: When I shift an inch, that's a room's width.

lines.zh: 你堵在门口，我出不去了。
lines.en: You're blocking the doorway, and I can't get out.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的鳍会划开水面。
lines.en: Not so close; my fins slice the water.

lines.zh: 你退开的样子，我记住了。
lines.en: The way you back away — I've remembered it.

lines.zh: 三只就够守一座殿，不必再多。
lines.en: Three are enough to keep one temple; no more needed.

lines.zh: 我们不繁衍，我们是被留下的。
lines.en: We don't breed; we were left behind.

lines.zh: 顶上一只，两翼各一只，这是定数。
lines.en: One above, one on each wing; that is the count.

lines.zh: 你问我的同伴？它们从不看我。
lines.en: My companions? They never look at me.

lines.zh: 两千年了，一只没多，一只没少。
lines.en: Two thousand years: not one more, not one less.

lines.zh: 守卫者会生，我们只守着它们生。
lines.en: The guardians breed; we only watch them.

lines.zh: 配对这种事，石头早就忘了。
lines.en: Pairing is something the stone forgot long ago.

lines.zh: 我的同类在侧翼，隔着水听我。
lines.en: My kin on the wings hear me through the water.

lines.zh: 别指望我们结伴，我们只是同守。
lines.en: Don't expect us to keep company; we merely share a watch.

lines.zh: 等神殿塌了，我们也就散了。
lines.en: When the temple falls, we'll scatter too.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只扣下东西。
lines.en: I don't pick things up; I confiscate them.

lines.zh: 你的剑沉到殿底，就当供奉。
lines.en: Your sword sinks to the floor; consider it an offering.

lines.zh: 那块海晶石，你带不走的。
lines.en: That prismarine — you won't be taking it.

lines.zh: 我什么都不拿，我只要人留下。
lines.en: I take nothing; I only ask that you stay.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西，自然归神殿。
lines.en: Whatever sinks belongs to the temple in time.

lines.zh: 你掉的那把镐，我替你看着。
lines.en: That dropped pickaxe, I'll keep an eye on it.

lines.zh: 别在我面前捡东西，很难看。
lines.en: Don't pick things up before me; it's unseemly.

lines.zh: 我这里没有口袋，只有门。
lines.en: I have no pockets here, only doors.

lines.zh: 沉船上的东西，都归我管。
lines.en: Whatever comes off sunken ships answers to me.

lines.zh: 你捡走的每一块砖，都要还回来。
lines.en: Every tile you take must be returned.

lines.zh: 你踩到了神殿的地砖。
lines.en: You stepped on the temple's tile.

lines.zh: 你身后的门，已经合上了。
lines.en: The door behind you has closed.

lines.zh: 我闻到你带进来的空气了。
lines.en: I smell the air you brought in with you.

lines.zh: 那只守卫者叫了，它在报你。
lines.en: That guardian cried out; it was reporting you.

lines.zh: 你挖第一块砖时，我就看着。
lines.en: I was watching when you mined the first tile.

lines.zh: 三只眼睛同时转过来，你该走了。
lines.en: Three eyes turn at once. You should leave.

lines.zh: 这里的东西，一件都不许动。
lines.en: Nothing here may be touched.

lines.zh: 你正好在我正下方，很难得。
lines.en: You're directly below me. That's rare.

lines.zh: 我把你记进神殿的名册了。
lines.en: I've entered you into the temple's ledger.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，比鱼吵得多。
lines.en: Your footsteps are far louder than any fish.

lines.zh: 这一层归我守，你也归我管。
lines.en: This level is my watch, and so are you.

lines.zh: 想拿走什么，先过我这一关。
lines.en: To take anything, you get past me first.

lines.zh: 不用问你名字，我认得活气。
lines.en: No need for your name; I know the smell of life.

lines.zh: 从你进门起，我就在你背后。
lines.en: I've been behind you since you entered.

lines.zh: 看着我的眼睛，你的手会变慢。
lines.en: Look into my eye, and your hands slow.

lines.zh: 我送你的礼物叫疲倦，收下吧。
lines.en: The gift I give is weariness. Accept it.

lines.zh: 你举镐的手，已经在抖了。
lines.en: The hand holding your pickaxe is already trembling.

lines.zh: 越挖越慢，这是我的规矩。
lines.en: The more you dig, the slower you go. That's my rule.

lines.zh: 我的光，正在你身上爬。
lines.en: My light is crawling over you.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉，这里每面墙我都熟。
lines.en: You can't run; I know every wall here.

lines.zh: 三只守卫，都已经醒了。
lines.en: All three of us are awake now.

lines.zh: 水会替我按住你。
lines.en: The water will hold you down for me.

lines.zh: 你数着气泡，迟早会数错。
lines.en: Count your bubbles; sooner or later you'll lose count.

lines.zh: 我的诅咒，从来不看盔甲。
lines.en: My curse has never cared about armor.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，你就举不起镐了。
lines.en: One more step, and you won't lift that pickaxe.

lines.zh: 你听，守卫者在笑。
lines.en: Listen. The guardians are laughing.

lines.zh: 我的光柱，已经对准你了。
lines.en: My beam is already aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我不用追，门只有一道。
lines.en: I needn't chase; there's only one door.

lines.zh: 你挖得越深，手越沉。
lines.en: The deeper you dig, the heavier your hands.

lines.zh: 我在你背后，一直在。
lines.en: I am behind you. I always was.

lines.zh: 光从眼里出去，穿过了水。
lines.en: Light leaves my eye and cuts through the water.

lines.zh: 我的刺，擦过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My spines graze your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的镐差点脱手。
lines.en: That one nearly knocked the pickaxe from your hand.

lines.zh: 水里没有血，只有红。
lines.en: There's no blood in water, only red.

lines.zh: 别躲立柱后面，光会拐弯。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the pillar; the light bends.

lines.zh: 我的尾一扫，砖就碎了。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail and the tile cracks.

lines.zh: 你后退了三格，很好。
lines.en: You fell back three blocks. Good.

lines.zh: 我咬得很慢，因为不着急。
lines.en: I bite slowly, because I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 这一击，带着两千年的力气。
lines.en: This blow carries two thousand years of strength.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，在我眼里是一层沙。
lines.en: Your armor looks like a layer of sand to me.

lines.zh: 光散开时，你会站不稳。
lines.en: When the light spreads, you'll lose your footing.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，水替你受了。
lines.en: I ram you once; the water takes the worst of it.

lines.zh: 神殿的地砖，认得你的膝盖了。
lines.en: The temple tiles know your knees now.

lines.zh: 你还站着，我有点意外。
lines.en: You're still standing. That surprises me a little.

lines.zh: 神殿落成那天，我就在顶上了。
lines.en: I was on the roof the day the temple was finished.

lines.zh: 一座殿三只，我是顶上那一只。
lines.en: Three to a temple; I'm the one on top.

lines.zh: 我从海晶石里睁开眼睛。
lines.en: I open my eyes out of the prismarine.

lines.zh: 两千年没动过，今天动一动。
lines.en: Two thousand years still; today I'll move.

lines.zh: 侧翼那两只，是我兄弟。
lines.en: Those two on the wings are my brothers.

lines.zh: 海水先冷下来，然后我才在。
lines.en: The water cools first, and then I am here.

lines.zh: 我生来比守卫者大上一号。
lines.en: I was born one size larger than the guardians.

lines.zh: 顶上那间房空着，我填了进去。
lines.en: The room above stood empty, so I filled it.

lines.zh: 这殿的每一块砖，都有我的影子。
lines.en: Every tile here carries my shadow.

lines.zh: 我睁眼的时候，鱼全都散了。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, all the fish scattered.

lines.zh: 三声低鸣之后，我才浮起来。
lines.en: After three low calls, I rise.

lines.zh: 我不是被生下来的，是被留下的。
lines.en: I wasn't born; I was left behind.

lines.zh: 神殿的钟没响，我自己醒了。
lines.en: The temple bell didn't ring; I woke on my own.

lines.zh: 这一层的水，从此归我。
lines.en: This level's water belongs to me from now on.

lines.zh: 三只里我醒得最晚。
lines.en: Of the three, I wake last.

lines.zh: 海晶石裂开，我浮出来。
lines.en: The prismarine splits and I float free.

lines.zh: 这一层的水，认了我。
lines.en: The water on this floor knows me.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，我的影子到了。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 鱼群先散，我才出现。
lines.en: The fish scatter first. Then I appear.

lines.zh: 我落座时，砖沉了一寸。
lines.en: When I settle, the brick sinks an inch.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧不久，我也是。
lines.en: Fire doesn't last in water, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 我本就在水底，摔不到哪去。
lines.en: I'm already at the bottom; there's nowhere to fall.

lines.zh: 我在水里两千年，你问我呛不呛？
lines.en: Two thousand years in water, and you ask if I choke?

lines.zh: 神殿的墙裂了，你赔不起。
lines.en: The temple wall cracked. You can't afford it.

lines.zh: 箭在水里慢下来，正好让我看清。
lines.en: The arrow slows in the water, just enough for me to see it.

lines.zh: 魔法绕着我的壳滑走了。
lines.en: Magic slides right off my shell.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也不觉得空。
lines.en: I eat nothing, and feel no emptiness.

lines.zh: 雷进了海，整座殿亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning entered the sea; the whole temple flashed.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，也没有神殿。
lines.en: Below there's neither water nor temple.
